annotations.title: Biggest price drops of the last 24 hours

description: Discounts at rated shops today, biggest absolute saving first: with 30 days of our own history for the offer, the discount is measured only against its lowest price in the 30 days before the reduction (EU Omnibus, CJEU C-330/23; discount_basis "lowest_30d", price_before = lowest_30d); until that history exists, only against the old price the shop itself states (discount_basis "shop_stated", not verified by us, at most 50 %). Never an average or other shops' prices. For one country, optionally one category of any level and a minimum percent. for one country and optionally one category slug (from the deal categories). Shops on a risk list and shops without a rating are never included. Each row carries the current price, the previous price, the drop, the shop with its trust label and the capture time. Next: find_best_price with the product name for the full comparison.

category.description: Category slug of any level of the tree, e.g. mobily, elektronika, televize.

country.description: Country of the shops. Default: the first compared country.

max_per_shop.description: Shop diversity: the first 48 rows take the shops in turns, at most this many rows per shop; the rest follows by saving. The website asks 4.

min_percent.description: Only discounts of at least this many percent.

stated_only.description: Kept for compatibility; every row carries a struck price (the offer's 30-day low or, until 30 days of history exist, the shop's stated price), with or without it.
